items.title: Joe Robichaux Interview, 1959-03-19
items.q: I told him Schalke is the, it's just about the oldest Dixon and trumpet player we have now. ... a lot of fellas knew of him that had been here, but the others didn't, you know.

ctx.x: It makes you sick to read about this.

Yeah, I'm telling you, it really was an awful tragedy. And so anyway, he's getting along pretty good. He's getting along pretty good. And he said that the television show was the first wake he had since before Christmas. Well, I'm glad he was able to work with him. Yeah, he was able to work. And they had a tenor player with him, could play some tenor. And he wasn't on the show, but that's the group that he plays with. And this tenor player, he was terrific. Then I met Stan Getz. He lives in. Did he open there?…
Some people tell me at times that Schalke plays a lot, or one time played a lot like Kid Rene, too.
